zones.name: Khanshahwali
zones.notes: Central market cluster. Highest commercial waste density; weekly bazaar day drives a sharp Monday spike.
zones.image_caption: Khandwa Railway Station footbridge. Representative image of the city.

zones.name: Anand Nagar
zones.notes: Mixed residential. Some households segregate reliably; most do not.
zones.image_caption: Kishore Kumar memorial, Khandwa. Representative image of the city.

zones.name: Bengali Colony
zones.notes: Older residential lanes. Collection routes frequent; recovery infrastructure absent.
zones.image_caption: Gauri Kunj, Kishore Kumar's house, Khandwa. Representative image.

zones.name: Padam Nagar
zones.notes: Residential with newer housing stock. Higher awareness, moderate segregation uptake.
zones.image_caption: Jal Mahotsav craft bazaar, Khandwa. Representative image of the city.

zones.name: Civil Lines
zones.notes: Administrative and low-density residential. Best servicing in the city; street canopy is the highest of the eight.
zones.image_caption: Kishore Kumar memorial, Khandwa. Representative image.

zones.name: Ghaspura
zones.notes: Dense older core. Narrow lanes limit collection vehicles; mixed waste the norm.
zones.image_caption: Khandwa Railway Station footbridge. Representative image.

zones.name: Imlipura
zones.notes: Mixed residential and small trade. Informal scrap recovery picks up part of the gap.
zones.image_caption: Jal Mahotsav craft bazaar, Khandwa. Representative image.

zones.name: Ganesh Talai
zones.notes: Older neighbourhood around the lake side. Waterfront waste handling is the visible weak point.
zones.image_caption: Gauri Kunj, Kishore Kumar's house, Khandwa. Representative image.
